name: Screen memory
summary: Remembers the text that was on your screen, off until you turn it on.

requires.why: To see the screen when you have turned this on.
To keep only the words, never the picture.
For the screenshot while it is read.

settings.label: Remember what is on screen
settings.hint: Off until you turn it on. Only the words are kept, never the picture, and never from a password manager, a sign-in window, a game or the lock screen.

settings.label: Never remember these apps
settings.hint: Process names, separated by commas. Nothing is kept while one of them is the window in front.
